x-fal-metadata.about:
# Topaz Generative Image Upscale (Wonder)

Generative upscaling that reconstructs and invents detail the
source no longer has.

## Models
- **Wonder 3** — Topaz's most advanced generative realism model
(default).
- **Wonder** — one-click repair for low/medium resolution images.
- **Standard MAX** — high-quality upscaling with generative help.
- **Redefine** — prompt-guided creative upscaling (`prompt`,
`creativity`, `texture`).
- **Recovery / Recovery V2** — rebuild extreme low-resolution
images.

Classic (non-generative) upscaling that stays faithful to the
source pixels.

## Models
- **Standard V2** — general-purpose, fits most photos.
- **High Fidelity V2** — preserves fine detail in professional
shots.
- **Low Resolution V2** — recovers compressed, low-quality sources.
- **CGI** — artwork and rendered graphics.
- **Text Refine** — keeps text and shapes crisp.
- **Faces** — Face Recovery 3, restores facial detail.

x-fal-metadata.about:
# Topaz Generative Video Upscale (Starlight)

Diffusion-based restoration and upscaling that regenerates detail
the source no longer has.

## Models
- **Starlight Precise 2.6** — realism pass for AI-generated video.
- **Starlight HQ** — maximum quality on high-resolution sources.
- **Starlight Mini** — diffusion restoration for archival footage.
- **Starlight Sharp** — fast restoration with sharper detail.
- **Starlight Fast 2** — the fastest, cheapest diffusion upscaler.

Videos are limited to 5 minutes. `target_fps` enables Apollo frame
interpolation only when it differs from the source FPS.

x-fal-metadata.about:
# Topaz Precision Video Upscale

Classic (non-generative) upscaling and enhancement that stays
faithful to the source.

## Models
- **Proteus** — the default choice for most real-world footage.
- **Artemis HQ / MQ / LQ** — denoise and sharpen, for progressively
more degraded sources.
- **Gaia HQ / CG** — refinement for high-quality footage and CG
renders.
- **Gaia 2** — frame-by-frame 2x upscaling for animation and motion
graphics (billed at half price).
- **Rhea** — maximum fine detail via an internal 4x pass.

Videos are limited to 5 minutes. `target_fps` enables Apollo frame
interpolation only when it differs from the source FPS.
